dialogues.speaker: Atzi
dialogues.text: She's a doctor, so she's super busy! She's often out working, and she even brings delicious food back home.

dialogues.speaker: Atzi
dialogues.text: But whenever she's not out, she takes me to see Granny Itztli...

dialogues.speaker: Atzi
dialogues.text: Mom always brings Granny Citlali cabbages, Grainfruit, and herbs. After that, she gets Granny to teach me some classes and leave me some homework...

dialogues.speaker: Atzi
dialogues.text: Granny's homework is always so hard... Y'know what? Come to think of it, it's best that adults stay busy!
